description: Convert the Replit-based Co-Host app to a local Mac Mini version. Remove Replit Auth, Stripe billing, and credits system. Add simple user/password auth. Migrate PostgreSQL to SQLite. Create a professional design system with CSS custom properties.

userStories.title: Remove Replit Auth and replace with local user/password auth
userStories.description: Remove all Replit OpenID/passport auth code. Replace with a simple Express session-based auth using username/password from environment variables (AUTH_USER, AUTH_PASSWORD in .env). Create a simple login page. Protect all routes and WebSocket connections. Keep session management.

userStories.title: Remove Stripe billing and credits system
userStories.description: Remove all Stripe integration, credit packages, checkout pages, usage tracking, and webhook handlers. Remove stripe, stripe-replit-sync dependencies. Remove Credits page, CheckoutSuccess/Cancel pages, UsageDashboard. Remove credit-checking middleware from routes. The app should work without any billing restrictions.

userStories.title: Migrate PostgreSQL to SQLite with Drizzle ORM
userStories.description: Replace PostgreSQL with better-sqlite3/libsql. Update drizzle.config.ts for SQLite dialect. Migrate all schema definitions (shared/schema.ts) to SQLite-compatible types. Update server/db.ts and server/storage.ts. Remove pg, connect-pg-simple dependencies. Add better-sqlite3. Ensure all queries work with SQLite. Create initial migration.

userStories.title: Professional Design System with CSS Custom Properties
userStories.description: Create a global CSS design system using CSS custom properties (--color-primary, --color-background, --font-family, --spacing-*, --radius-*, etc.). Refactor existing Tailwind classes to use these variables where appropriate. Create a theme.css file that can be easily customized. Ensure the app looks professional and consistent. Dark mode should be the default.

userStories.title: Update README and .env.example for local setup
userStories.description: Rewrite README.md with clear local setup instructions. Update .env.example with all needed variables (AUTH_USER, AUTH_PASSWORD, DEEPGRAM_API_KEY, ELEVENLABS_API_KEY, GOOGLE_AI_API_KEY, OPENAI_API_KEY). Add npm scripts for dev and production. Document the architecture.

userStories.title: Clean up Replit artifacts and unused code
userStories.description: Remove all Replit-specific code, configurations, and references. Remove replit_integrations folder, .replit references, vite replit plugins. Clean up package.json dependencies. Ensure the app starts cleanly with npm run dev.
